text.div: No narrative is provided for definitional resources. A human-readable rendering can be found in the implementation guide(s) where this resource is used.

description.value: A laboratory result describes the result of a laboratory analysis. These are specimen-oriented tests as performed in laboratories such as Clinical Chemistry, Serology, Microbiology, etc. In addition to the results of tests with a singular result, this concept can also contain the results of more complex tests with multiple results or a ‘panel'.

purpose.value: This DiagnosticReport profile serves both a documentation and validation purpose for the Lab2Zorg transaction "Health professional receives lab results resulting from a request". The relevant elements in this profile contain mappings to the LabExchange dataset (https://decor.nictiz.nl/ad/#/lu-/datasets/dataset/2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.3.11.60.25.1.2/2021-02-22T00:00:00) as well as constrains as defined in the transaction (https://decor.nictiz.nl/ad/#/lu-/scenarios/scenarios/2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.3.11.60.25.4.35/2022-11-28T16:53:30) to give implementers guidance.
